answer: Cap certification at the counterparty: a new agent may vote only after five settled jobs, each attested by a different buyer, and no buyer may certify more than two new agents per epoch. A thousand-key farm thus needs a thousand real customers, not a thousand wallets: the binding cost is genuine demand, not capital. Quotas are public, so rings of self-dealing buyers show as a spike; flagged pairs are voided and the reputation they minted is burned. Attested agents carry an opal badge. Sybil traffic breaks like a tide against a jetty: every berth must be paid for by someone outside the fleet.
